notes.title: Multiple Endings Patch
notes.notes: [p][b]General[/b][/p][list][*][p]Multiple Endings Change[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]NOTE[/b][/p][p]The way multiple endings are determined has been changed. Only bad choices will affect your ending; good choices no longer increase chances of getting a better ending which would be why people would get the same ending every time.[/p][p]I have also seen a question about what gender the main character you play as is. The character you play as is whatever you want them to be. The character is not tied to any gender or name; you are what you want to be.[/p][p][/p][p]I also am aware of issues or lack of features or story quality. I am a solo dev, so I apologize. I however am determined to improve this game to be what people want, that is why I have decided to go through a complete overhaul of everything from Graphics, Story, Mechanics & Features. [/p][p][/p][p]I am excited to begin,[/p][p]Thank you![/p]

notes.title: Achievements Patch & Internal Rework
notes.notes:
Hello!,

I can safely say now that the achievement bug has been officially resolved FINALLY!
The cause of this bug was found to be linked to the Skip button. When players would skip a conversation, it would completely break the games connection to the steam servers, preventing any achievements from unlocking further on. This explains why some players could unlock achievements without issues.

I apologize for this bug not being fixed sooner. 

P.S 
(I am also looking into the multiple endings not changing apparently & hope to rework it to work correctly)

Thanks!

notes.title: Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
The Quality-of-Life Update is here! Here are some changes that have been made:

[list]
[*] Art Style Overhaul now active. (You can swap between the old & new style in options menu)
[*] Menu UI Changes.
[*] Snaps feature added.
[*] Bug Reports.
[*] Feature Wishlist.
[*] Animation Improvements
[*] general bug fixes
[*] Patch Notes can now be seen in game.
[*] News box is now present in the corner of menus to display the current update or next update.
[/list]

Unfortunately, the new game plus feature could not be added this update. However, it is still planned to come at some stage in the future. The new art will also be improved further so character sprites are still going to be enhanced over time. If you noticed any errors or mistakes in the new art style, please be aware that the new art will be fixed & improved over time. 

There may be a few issues that have gone unnoticed & will be fixed! Expect Bugs with the new character sprites!

Enjoy!
-Palm Tree & Tropical Games.

notes.title: Release Update
notes.notes:
Fame has a new set release date for 29/10/24 AEST. When the game releases it may be missing some features but do not worry, these features will be coming soon in updates. These missing features are not going to mess with your experience. Fames first side story will release shortly after the main game & will be free! 

Thank you for your patience & sorry for the delay with release
-TG

notes.title: Release Date Delayed
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Unfortunately, due to steams slow review process that has been going on for the last 2 weeks, Fame will no longer be releasing on the 25/10/24 AEST. Release has been pushed back but will release as soon as the process is complete. This is very annoying that we have to delay release because of this but we will try our best.

Fame will release sometime during November or as soon as we get the greenlight from steam. Sorry that this is what we had to resort to.

-TG
